result.reason: The revised cap is mutual and matches the preferred monetary formulation in substance, although “all amounts” is broader than the specified fees basis. However, the operative language does not establish the required mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages or clarify that Customer payment obligations are not damages subject to the cap. The required carve-outs also cannot be verified because “Excluded Claims” is not defined in the supplied language; the margin comment cannot substitute for operative terms. The amendment is otherwise focused and professionally drafted.
